name: WG TECH (Jiang Xi) Co., Ltd.
summary: WG TECH (Jiang Xi) Co., Ltd. is a company based in Xinyu, China, that operates across the full spectrum of activities, from research and development to the production, processing, and sale of photoelectric glass products within the Chinese market. Its primary offerings include TFT-LCD glass panels, as well as solutions for ITO coating and LCD cutting. The firm was established in 2009.
